allowed_deviations: Before any DMS outcome, high-value membership, proxy-performance result or acquisition result is read, an assay may be excluded only for a retained failure of a frozen eligibility check: source/provenance/license, candidate/label semantics, exact candidate/truth/score alignment, 100% finite selected-proxy coverage, leakage-safe identity, or immutable readback.

At most two main execution attempts are permitted in the cumulative envelope. A second attempt may follow only an externally evidenced scheduler preemption, host interruption or transient local-I/O failure with no complete terminal and unchanged contract/input/source/environment, or a pre-result implementation repair that preserves this scientific contract, uses a new reviewed commit and Run-pinned identity, and passes fresh technical review. No result-driven retry is permitted.

Outcome-free implementation repair before the first attempt may change source identity without changing the contract; every such change requires a new exact commit/tree and technical review before execution.

Per assay, method and state, the label budget is initial observations 32 or 64 plus one batch of 16; branch-local evaluator reads do not create independent assay units. The selected public zero-shot score is pre-existing observable information and has zero label cost in M5C; no monetary low-fidelity cost claim is made. Proposed main-execution cumulative caps across at most two attempts are 86,400 wall seconds, 1,382,400 CPU seconds, 48,000,000,000 process-tree peak RSS bytes, 32,212,254,720 scratch high-water bytes, 4,294,967,296 staging/network bytes and 100 CNY, with zero ordinary-run COS writes and no new paid resource purchase. Proposed Mika aggregate-only reproduction caps are 3,600 wall seconds, 7,200 CPU seconds, 4,000,000,000 RSS bytes, 2,147,483,648 scratch bytes, 1,073,741,824 network bytes and 5 CNY. Target host is the observed SSH target protein-6000 (hostname ps), but execution is blocked until /srv/pcdb, group pcdb, writer membership, backup/RPO and capacity checks pass on that host. These values are a proposal and are not inherited from M5B.

scientific_contract.held_out_boundary: Before final Gate A and successful outcome-free eligibility/input checks: zero DMS truth, high-value membership, static proxy performance or acquisition outcome reads. After authorization, full per-assay DMS truth may be read only inside the hidden-oracle/evaluator capability to derive frozen high-value definitions, evaluate the sealed M2-static proxy baseline and reveal initial/selected branch labels. Surrogates and acquisitions receive only sequence-composition features plus the branch's revealed observations; the proxy column is isolated from those arms. Public reporting is aggregate-only and excludes candidate IDs, raw labels, membership, boundary scores and score distributions. scientific_contract.research_question: Across the complete prospective four-assay ProteinGym cohort, does the frozen same-state one-batch acquisition intervention produce immediate decision value relative to model-matched Greedy and overlap-matched Random, and do the pre-registered mechanism classifications replicate, reverse or remain heterogeneous across independent assays? M5B's accepted L1 INCONCLUSIVE terminal is motivation only and is not a redundancy premise.
scientific_contract.statistical_rule: The assay is the primary scientific unit. Each assay has 40 paired states (2 models x initial sizes 32/64 x seeds 1729..1738), batch size 16, and branch set G/E/M00..M63. Matched Random preserves E-intersection-G and samples the remaining divergence from remaining_pool-minus-G with the M5B counter-based SHA-256 rule namespaced to m5c-proteingym-one-step-v1. For each assay and contrast, use 20,000 deterministic cluster-bootstrap draws: resample the ten seed slots jointly across models within each initial size, resample 64 matched replicates within an E-M state occurrence, equal-weight the four model-by-initial cells, and use Hyndman-Fan type-7 quantiles 0.003125/0.996875 (99.375% two-sided intervals for eight primary assay-by-contrast tests). Equivalence margin is one nominal primary high-value candidate, delta=1/K_assay. Contrast status precedence is SUPERIOR, INFERIOR, EQUIVALENT, NONINFERIOR_ONLY, INCONCLUSIVE as in M5B. Per-assay taxonomy precedence is VALIDITY_STOP; UNDEFINED_INCONCLUSIVE; FRAGILE_INCONCLUSIVE for primary tie expansion above 2% or strict sign reversal by 0.5%/2% sensitivity; UNSTABLE for opposite model-by-initial cell effects beyond delta; then BEHAVIOR_REDUNDANCY when mean divergence count <=1, max <=2 and both contrasts are EQUIVALENT; UNINFORMATIVE_DEVIATION when E-M is EQUIVALENT and E-G INFERIOR; OPPORTUNITY_COST when E-M SUPERIOR and E-G EQUIVALENT/INFERIOR; CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE when both SUPERIOR; OTHER_NEGATIVE for any remaining INFERIOR; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Cohort classification is REPLICATED_<label> only when at least two eligible assays share one non-inconclusive mechanism label and no eligible assay has a different non-inconclusive mechanism label; HETEROGENEOUS when at least two different non-inconclusive labels occur or a primary contrast is SUPERIOR in one assay and INFERIOR in another; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Fewer than three eligible assays yields ELIGIBILITY_INCONCLUSIVE. No pooled-seed or pseudo-replicate inference is allowed. Report all assay rows, exclusions, unweighted descriptive effect range/mean, label counts and required aggregate inputs: frozen/actual high-value counts, boundary-tie counts, 40 divergence counts, four cell estimates, bootstrap point/interval/status, sensitivity point estimates, defined/validity flags and attempt selection. M2-static Spearman and high-value recall at 0.5%/1%/2% are descriptive secondary baseline outputs and never alter taxonomy. The first complete valid terminal is canonical; valid negative, heterogeneous or inconclusive outcomes stop the v1 slice.
